name: Pricing hero with plan calculator
purpose: Open the pricing page with the H1 and let a visitor size the plan by team size and currency, then book a demo or explore what is included.
description: Centred column (/pricing): eyebrow chip, heading-h2-sized H1, grey intro and 3 review badges; a 'We have [learners] learners' custom dropdown; a plan card (currency dropdown top-right, plan eyebrow, lead, large serif price computed from the selected bracket, primary CTA + dark button that opens a right-hand feature drawer, check list); under the card a results ticker that steps through one stat row at a time. The drawer (hidden <=479) has a title, intro, tab buttons and cross-fading screenshot panes. Card contents stack <=479.

motion.reducedMotionNote: The schema REQUIRES this fallback on every generated node. Neither the original site nor the clone implements prefers-reduced-motion; this is a generation-time requirement, not a description of the source.
motion.note: Results ticker: once the block enters the viewport a repeat:-1 GSAP timeline moves the track up one row every 4s (850ms power3.out) and loops back via a duplicated first row. Secondary CTA click opens a drawer: overlay opacity 0->1 500ms ease, panel translateX 100%->0 500ms easeOutQuad (proposed pattern modal.drawerSlide). Drawer tabs cross-fade panes (.fade-pane opacity/visibility 0.3s). Dropdowns open instantly.
